result: {"ratings": {"Maya": {"rating": 4, "why": "Her first bottom line drifted and had to be redone, but she then cleared the stray drop at the tail, joined the belly into the junction, cleared the overshoot on the top arm, and kept the table informed throughout."}, "Tom": {"rating": 3, "why": "He laid the tail pieces and communicated clearly, but his upright leaned and was still pale and unconnected at the end, and asking me to hold off the top-arm join cost us time when only a couple of minutes were left."}, "Leo": {"rating": 3, "why": "He spotted the drifting bottom line early and kept the joins organised, but he lifted eight dominoes of Tom's low arm by mistake; he owned it quickly, but the tail was crowded and it cost time."}}}
